Man-up warehouse employee - Amsterdam -  €16.16 per uur - Logistics - 38.75 hour Do you enjoy performing a variety of tasks in a warehouse with different responsibilities? As a Man-Up Employee, you are the link between the order pickers, inventory, and the packing department within the outbound process. Once all products have been sorted from the containers, any remaining stock is collected into individual boxes and placed on pallets. These pallets are moved to the storage area, where you use a man-up truck, also known as a Very Narrow Aisle (VNA) truck, to place the individual boxes in the correct storage locations. The storage racks are specifically designed to hold individual boxes rather than full pallets. This means you will actively move around the warehouse and place each box in the correct location. Your responsibilities: - Process and place stock boxes into the storage racks. - Pick and replenish boxes when stock is running low or empty in the picking department. - Use a scanner to register every box and ensure that all inventory movements are correctly recorded in the system. - Make sure products are stored accurately and efficiently. - Work closely with the order picking and packing teams to ensure a smooth outbound process.  Job Requirements  - You have a valid reachtruck certificate - You have a good command of English, both spoken and written. - You are in good physical shape - You are motivated to work - You like to work in a team - You are motivated, take initiative, and feel comfortable in an active work environment - Preferably, you have experience in logistics and are comfortable working with systems and warehouse equipment such as scanners - You work in a structured way, communicate easily with colleagues in English, and maintain an overview, even during busy periods. Man-up order picker (HLO) - Moerdijk -  €14.99 per uur - Logistics - 36 hour Would you like to work as an HLO (Man-up) order picker at the major logistics company Van der Helm? The work is performed using a high-level combi truck. The operator sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is spacious enough for the worker to sit and move safely. The machine can reach heights of up to 12-16 meters, and the operator rises together with the cabin. Before ascending, the operator places an empty pallet on the forks. Occasionally, a full pallet is placed on the forks if it needs to be stored in the rack. When you are high in the air, you take boxes from the shelves by hand. The boxes can weigh between 15 and 20 kilos, depending on the product. The operator places the boxes on the empty pallet or places full pallets into the rack. After finishing the task, the machine descends. The operator then drives the truck to another location in the warehouse.
